headline: Packers 24-20 Falcons: Love delivers on Alumni Weekend, Penix valiant in return
whyCareReason: Week 3 TNF in the books. Packers improve to 2-1 as Jordan Love tallies three touchdowns at Lambeau. Michael Penix Jr. throws for 268 yards in his season debut.
teaser: FINAL: Green Bay Packers 24, Atlanta Falcons 20. Love two touchdown passes and a rushing score. Penix 268 yards in return.
story:
Why this one matters: Thursday Night Football launched Week 3 at iconic Lambeau Field on Alumni Weekend.

NFL.com and Sports Illustrated report that Jordan Love led Green Bay to a 24-20 victory over the Atlanta Falcons, throwing two touchdown passes and rushing for a 4-yard score. Green Bay moves to 2-1 on the season.

Michael Penix Jr. impressed in his first start since ACL surgery, completing 22 of 34 passes for 268 yards and a 28-yard touchdown strike to Drake London. But a fourth-quarter interception by Green Bay safety Xavier McKinney sealed the win for the Packers. Atlanta falls to 0-3 ahead of their Week 4 contest.
stakes: Green Bay takes early control in the NFC North at 2-1, while Atlanta faces an uphill climb at 0-3.
rivalryAngle: An NFC clash between cold-weather tradition and dynamic southern speed under prime-time lights.
